title: Customer Communications Note: Card Expiry Reminders, Issuer Updates and Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Notice Channels
content:
For card methods of the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, a card expiry reminder is sent the method's reminder period before the end of the expiry month printed on the card on file. The reminder concerns the first due date after the card expires. Bank account methods receive no expiry reminders.

Where the method has the account updater and the issuer reports a new card number or expiry, the authorization is updated without a new enrollment.

A draft on an expired card is declined as an expired-card decline and counts as a failed due date.

Failed-draft and suspension notices go by the method's failure-notice channels, and enrollment, change and cancellation confirmations by the method's confirmation channels.

### Reminder date, worked (hypothetical reminder period of 30 days)

A card printed 08/27 expires at the end of August 2027, on 31 August 2027. Thirty days before that day is 1 August 2027, the day the reminder is sent; the reminder names the first due date after 31 August 2027.

### Points of judgement

- *A tenant on Personal Checking ACH asks when the expiry reminder will come.* Bank account methods receive no expiry reminders.
- *The issuer reports a new expiry for a card on a method with the account updater.* The authorization is updated without a new enrollment.
- *The card on file expired and the next draft ran on it.* The draft is declined as an expired-card decline, and that due date counts as failed.
